_about: Automation registry for health.py (the daily health check). Copy to automations.json and edit. One entry per automation that health.py should watch. JSON, not YAML: /usr/bin/python3 (3.9, stdlib only) must parse it. Scheduler tasks are NOT listed here: health.py reads every `Enabled: true` task from agents/scheduled-tasks.md and only takes per-task extras (outputs, grace, fix) from `scheduler_tasks.overrides`. Paths: relative = workspace root, `~` = home, `{date}` = the slot's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Times are judged in AWAKE minutes (pmset -g log full-wake intervals), not wall-clock. `scope` = the run-record folder a finding lands in (default `general`). `fix` = the one-line hint printed next to a failure, keyed by failure code. Entry kinds: launchd-job (checks: plist, tick, slot), server (plist, http), mcp (mcp-registered, mcp-credentials, mcp-reachable). Rule of thumb: no new automation without an entry here.

fix.missed: Open the lid ~10 min; check `tail -20 agents/scheduler/logs/cron.log` for 'deferred' / 'CLI not found'. Manual run: `TICK_SKIP_WAKE_CHECK=1 bash agents/scheduler/tick.sh`
fix.retry-cap: Read the failed run record in agents/scheduler/runs/, fix the cause, then delete the task's key from agents/scheduler/state/attempts.json (or wait for the next slot)
fix.failed: Open the task's latest run record (agents/scheduler/runs/) and the scheduler log: first error line
fix.output-stale: Task updated Last run but not its output: read its run record / scheduler log
fix.no-record: Task ran but wrote no run record: check prompt.md § Outcome report was followed

fix.failed: Run the review interactively with the agent and read the run record

automations.label: com.my-workspace.agent-scheduler
automations.schedule: every 10 min (StartInterval 600) + RunAtLoad; tick.sh -> gate.py -> claude -p
automations.how_to_check: Last `gate:` line in cron.log must be < 3h of AWAKE time old. A `starting` line with no later gate line = harness still running (hung after 3h).

fix.tick-stale: `launchctl list | grep agent-scheduler` (loaded? last exit?); reinstall: `bash agents/scheduler/install-launchd.sh`
fix.hung: A Claude run has been going for hours: `ps aux | grep 'claude -p'`; tail agents/scheduler/logs/cron.log

automations.label: com.my-workspace.rss-digest
automations.how_to_check: Today's digest file written after the 07:00 slot once the Mac has been awake 30 min past 07:00. Log written but digest not = the fetch crashed.

fix.missed: Run the fetch script by hand and read its log
fix.failed: `tail -30 agents/scheduler/logs/rss-digest.log`: the fetch ran but wrote no digest

automations.how_to_check: The server is registered in ~/.claude.json and the file named by NOTES_TOKEN_PATH in its env exists.

fix.mcp-registered: Register it again with `claude mcp add notes-search ...`
fix.mcp-credentials: Re-run the server's login step to recreate its token file
